name: skyvision-dashboard
description: OpenSkyCam dashboard: browse stored footage and pipeline statistics

scripts.dev: npm run config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.deploy: npm run config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.json --env ""
scripts.release: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply CATALOG --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json --env "" && wrangler d1 migrations apply API_KEYS --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json --env "" && npm run deploy
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:react
scripts.prestart: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply API_KEYS --config wrangler.deploy.json --env dev --local
scripts.types: npm run config && wrangler types --config wrangler.deploy.json src/models/runtimeSharedmodel.d.ts --env-interface WorkerBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.prestart:inference: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply CATALOG --config wrangler.deploy.json --env inference --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply API_KEYS --config wrangler.deploy.json --env inference --local
